name: Screen-space ambient occlusion for volume rendering
definition: Integrates SSAO into volume rendering by extracting per-fragment depth, world position, and surface normals from the volume ray-casting fragment shader, then feeding them into a standard SSAO pass to compute ambient occlusion for semi-transparent volumes.
summary: Screen-space ambient occlusion for volume rendering computes ambient occlusion for semi-transparent volumes by extracting geometric proxies from ray-casting data, differing from standard SSAO by handling volumetric rather than opaque surface geometry.
